qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: High contract density in guarding and electronic security solutions provides scale, but commoditized manned guarding and competitive procurement bidding suppress operating margins (6-8%) and multi-cycle ROIC below the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power, REJECT). Securitas possesses leading scale in security services, but core guarding is a commoditized, labor-intensive service with low switching costs. Historical ROIC (7-10%) consistently misses the 12% threshold.
qualitative.evidence: Normalized ROIC sits at 7.1% to 9.8% across data platforms (roic.ai 9.8%, GuruFocus 7.2-9.2%), missing the 12% requirement. Operating margins remain modest at 6.9% to 7.7% despite the acquisition of Stanley Security. Heavy reliance on manual guarding labor limits pricing power.
